title: mariscus cayennensis var. humilis
intro: Mariscus cayennensis var. humilis, commonly known as the Dwarf Papyrus Sedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus cayennensis var. humilis include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and its use as a diuretic, aiding in the treatment of urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
